note: From the OpenStreetMap main API export (tools/osm-to-kit.mjs, 13 October 2026), 1.25 times real across the line like the tracks: two side platforms about 100 m long on the Marple line, 2.1 m outside its two tracks (platform 1, towards Manchester, is the halt's), the footbridge over the middle of the platforms with its stairs down onto each, the station building behind platform 1's south half, the car park behind its north half off the approach from Gorton Road and Station Road, the covered cycle stands and ticket machine by the building's north end, and Gorton Road's bridge over the line just north of the platforms (its carriageway and both footways, skewed across the line). Positive v is north-east; the building and car park are on the south-west side. The view from above (docs/reference/aerial/reddish-north.jpg) shows the line in a shallow wooded cutting through North Reddish's terraces, Gorton Road crossing it at the north end. Photos (docs/reference/photos/reddish-north: platform-2-1.jpg Kevin Waterhouse 2024, platform-1-1.jpg, platform-1-2.jpg, platform-train-1.jpg, entrance-1.jpg and forecourt-1.jpg Gerald England 2015-18, building-1.jpg N Chadwick 2022, overview-1.jpg JThomas 2014): the building is single-storey red brick under a hipped slate roof, its end gable to the car park, with a valanced canopy on cast-iron columns along its platform front (the canopy, as long as the building); the footbridge is an open lattice one (the `lattice` part with a stair in two flights down onto each platform; which way each stair runs is read from platform-2-1.jpg and isn't sure); platform 2 has one small glazed shelter south of the footbridge and no building; Gorton Road's bridge is steel girders on brick abutments, drawn with the abutments set back from the tracks. The car park is at platform level on the forecourt, about 20 spaces from the area OSM maps (the count is a guess). No lifts in the photos: they're the game's, behind each platform at the footbridge. Platform 1's shelter, platform 2's canopy, the platform extensions at both ends, the kiosk and the café are the game's. The replacement bus stop on the approach from Gorton Road, from memory, placed by eye. Departure boards on each platform and on the building's front.
